definition: Road speed in km/h per 1000 engine rpm = 1000 / median(RPM per km/h). Includes final drive, tyre radius and slip. Not a pure gearbox ratio. Stable-gear sampling filters unchanged.
limitations: Phases are signal-based proxies, not mapped corner landmarks.
100 m bins use integrated sampled speed from first retained lap timestamp; gaps are not interpolated. These are approximate positions.
Low-RPM upshift proxy: within 0.75 s of an observed upshift above 250 km/h, RPM below 90% of same team-season/from-gear median, at least 3 shifts. Not proof of driver intent.
Single circuit, Monza qualifying. Median spacing about 0.24 s. Segment analysis is descriptive and does not tune or retest the predictor.
